description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ChangeEmail' used for changing a user's email address within a web application. It manages form state, validation, user interaction, and modal controls for the email change workflow.

methods.name: validateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Validates the user's current password by checking if it's entered and correct via application validation service.

methods.name: resetProgressState
methods.description: Resets the submission progress UI state to default.

methods.name: processEmailChange
methods.description: Performs the email change process including backing up data and calling the change email API.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Handles dialog dismissal, preventing close if pending operations are ongoing.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Main handler for the submit button that validates current password, initiates email change, and updates the UI state.

methods.name: handleDialogClose
methods.description: Handler for closing the dialog, respecting ongoing processes.
